aliases: Wi-Fi IP Plug-In 2K HD Deterrence Camera
release_notes: Night Owl CAM-FWIP4L: a plug-in Wi-Fi 2K deterrence camera with audio alerts, siren, and two-way audio. Consumer product-page specs — Night Owl does not publish sensor/lens details; unlisted fields omitted, form-factor inferred.

frigate.notes: Night Owl cameras stream through the Night Owl DVR/NVR — point Frigate at the recorder's IP, one channel per camera: /ch01/0 (main) and /ch01/1 (sub), where 01 is the channel number. No direct-to-camera ONVIF/RTSP. RTSP path from the community RTSP-patterns layer (issue #268).
